title: Sage's released policy against the split on net1 v4, on validation links
description: expliCCit reports that its split (net1 and net2) costs about 5% utilization and 9% queueing delay against Sage. Here Sage's released policy (release exp-sage-model-24, converted under sage-v1 and checked against TensorFlow; MIT-licensed) runs as a hold agent next to the fixed rule (u = 0.125) and the share rule (k = 1) on net1 v4, BBRv3, Cubic and BBRv1, on the five validation families (seed 11) and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s (experiments/copies.py, seed 11). Nothing is chosen here: Sage is released as it is and the split's candidates were fixed on validation earlier, so this checks that Sage runs as expected before the single test. Reported: log utility against BBRv3 per family, the copies' fairness and queueing delay, and utilization and queueing delay against Sage on the conditions where the flow is alone (experiments/sage_report.py).
prepare: G="$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; SAGE="$IN/sage/sage/sage.onnx"; echo "fc0d6f1da45e4948ee3d96784642793954ed5e52adc1eddd0c9883d5d8fe2f9e  $SAGE" | sha256sum -c; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v4" "$G" --u 0.125; uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$G" --u0 0.125 --k 1; P=(--policy "sage=$SAGE" --policy "rule-v4=$OUT/v4/rule-u0.125.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.125-k1.onnx"); experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 11 11 bbr3,cubic,bbr "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 11 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && uv run python experiments/copies_report.py "$OUT" && uv run python experiments/sage_report.py "$OUT"
